entry.text: Project Title Credit Risk (Paragon)
Position  Business Analyst
Date Jan 2019-May2022
Responsibilities:
• Worked as a conduit between the business users and development team in
translating the BRD ,FSD. FRD into technical specification.
• CARA- Assisting the Stakeholder fetching the Risk Rating details from Fitch and
Moody’ and Performing Credit Analysis for respective counterparty.

Reporting and PD, LGD, EAD models.

perspective, liaise with business to understand and accommodate the change
requests that are in scope.

documentation (preparing BRD, functional specification document, use case,
process flow diagrams), use case analysis, gap analysis and user training.
• Accountable for validating that the story meets acceptance criteria and it will
achieve the desired customer outcome.
• Spearheaded agile team meetings to break stories down into smaller stories that
comfortably fit in a sprint and have business values.
• Performed the data validation-testing, raise the defects with development team if
any, and re-validate them once fixed.
• Responsible for backlog refinement and preparation of planned releases,
prioritizing the team’s backlog and ensuring the backlog represents priorities of
the business.
